rows.information: Division of Agricultural Engineering, ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI), New Delhi

content_sections.heading: About IARI
content_sections.text: ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI) is located at Pusa, New Delhi-110012. Its Division of Agricultural Engineering is filling this post under the project "Development of an AI-based robotic precision transplanter for onion crop". The project is funded by DST, Ministry of Science and Technology, GOI.

content_sections.heading: IARI Junior Research Fellow Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: IARI Junior Research Fellow Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must be at least 18 and at most 35 years old. The application form asks for age as on the date of the interview. Under Govt. of India/ICAR Rules, the upper age limit is relaxed as follows: M.Tech./M.E. (Agricultural Engineering/Mechanical/Electronics Engineering/Manufacturing Engineering) with a 4/5 years Bachelor's degree. Candidates should also have qualified NET (ICAR/UGC/CSIR) or GATE, with two years of research experience. Expertise in agro-machine fabrication CAD for mechanical/electronic circuit development Computer programming: C, Python and Android Application programming Only candidates with the essential qualifications will be interviewed. Candidates who cannot show their essential degree completion certificate by the date of the interview cannot attend. For the full eligibility details, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by interview. The notice says eligible candidates may attend an offline interview on 23 November 2026 at 10:00 AM in the Conference Room, Division of Agricultural Engineering, IARI, Pusa, New Delhi. The institute will also tell applicants the mode of interview in advance by email or SMS, so applicants must have a working email address and mobile number. If candidates are given online slots, they must be available in their slot. Candidates who do not respond after repeated calls may not ordinarily be considered. The decision of the Joint Director (Research), ICAR-IARI, New Delhi will be final and binding in all respects.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely temporary and on a contractual basis. It ends with the project. It is offered initially for one year, or until the project tenure ends or the project is terminated, whichever is earlier. It can be extended for the rest of the project if performance is satisfactory. Selected candidates cannot claim a regular appointment or absorption in IARI or ICAR. Indiscipline or failure to carry out assigned duties can lead to termination under ICAR rules. The JRF gets no regular leave. CL and RH are allowed up to (8+2) = 10 days a year. The JRF is a full-time worker and must follow the administrative, financial and disciplinary rules of ICAR-IARI. Attendance is recorded in an attendance register.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IARI Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Complete bio-data in the application format Self-attested copies of certificates and mark sheets, with the original documents Original experience certificate (if any) No Objection Certificate from your employer, if you are currently employed Declaration Form about relatives at ICAR/IARI Any canvassing will disqualify the candidate. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. Which project is the IARI JRF post under?
faq.answer: The post is under the DST-funded project "Development of an AI-based robotic precision transplanter for onion crop" in the Division of Agricultural Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: The interview is in the Conference Room, Division of Agricultural Engineering, IARI, Pusa, New Delhi, on 23 November 2026 at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. Is NET or GATE compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must have qualified NET (ICAR/UGC/CSIR) or GATE and have two years of research experience.

faq.question: Q4. Which M.Tech./M.E. branches are accepted?
faq.answer: Agricultural Engineering, Mechanical, Electronics Engineering and Manufacturing Engineering, with a 4/5 years Bachelor's degree.

faq.question: Q5. How much age relaxation do women candidates get?
faq.answer: Women, like SC/ST candidates, get 5 years of relaxation on the upper age limit of 35 years. OBC candidates get 3 years.

faq.question: Q6. How many documents can I upload in the Google form?
faq.answer: All self-attested scanned documents must go together as one PDF file only.

faq.question: Q7. How long will the appointment last?
faq.answer: It runs initially for one year, or until the project ends, whichever is earlier. It can be extended for the rest of the project if performance is satisfactory.

faq.question: Q8. How much leave does the JRF get?
faq.answer: No regular leave is given. CL and RH are allowed up to a total of 10 days a year (8+2).

faq.question: Q9. Will travel costs for the interview be paid?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.
